articles.title: Hunter Biden debuts 'LAPTOP' memecoin targeting TRUMP holders
articles.snippet: LAPTOP debuts Wednesday on Base, with nearly a third of the supply set to be burned if a slate of political and market outcomes — including a Democratic win in 2028 — comes good.

articles.title: Oil up, bitcoin down as U.S. strikes Iranian crude carriers
articles.snippet: Bitcoin trades lower by nearly 1% as escalating U.S.-Iran hostilities push oil higher.

articles.title: Bitcoin sidechain Liquid pauses after purported ‘white hats’ withdraw $320M in BTC
articles.snippet: The actors told Blockstream they would return most of the 4,000 BTC after the Elements vulnerability is patched across the network.

articles.title: TikTok's Parent Company Just Borrowed $30 Billion to Go All-In on AI
articles.snippet: Nearly 30 banks backed the rare unsecured facility as TikTok’s parent company spends heavily on AI chips, models, and overseas data centers.
